description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_ContentSets', which manages content sets used by the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for merging module content sets, generating child element definitions, and converting string lists into lookup arrays.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ContentSets
classes.description: Manages content sets for the HTMLPurifier library, merging module content, generating element child definitions, and maintaining lookup information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes content sets based on provided modules, merging their content and expanding identifiers.

methods.name: generateChildDef
methods.description: Creates and assigns a child definition considering the content model and module specifications.

methods.name: generateChildDefCallback
methods.description: Callback function used during preg_replace_callback to replace content set identifiers with their actual definitions.

methods.name: getChildDef
methods.description: Instantiates and returns a ChildDef object based on the content model type, deferring to modules if necessary.

methods.name: convertToLookup
methods.description: Converts a pipe-separated string of elements into an associative lookup array.
